Betoken is a decentralized investment fund built on Ethereum smart contracts. Betoken pools funds from participants without a traditional fund manager. Betoken uses its BTKN token so that holders can vote on investment decisions.

Cover is a decentralized insurance protocol built on Ethereum smart contracts. Cover offers coverage against smart contract failures through risk pools that users fund. Cover uses its COVER token in governance of the protocol.

Polymarket is a decentralized prediction market platform that runs on the Polygon blockchain. Polymarket lets users trade shares on the outcomes of binary events. Polymarket settles trades in USDC stablecoin.

DeFi Pulse is an analytics platform that tracks the total value locked across DeFi protocols. DeFi Pulse presents its data through public dashboards. DeFi Pulse issues the DPI index token that tracks a basket of DeFi assets.

Polymath is a blockchain platform that provides a framework for issuing security tokens on Ethereum. Polymath enables issuers to create tokens that comply with securities rules through its token standards. Polymath uses its POLY token within its ecosystem.
